question: Will HYPE cross above $78.00 on Binance Futures on Saturday, August 22, 2026?

model.prompt_context:

- "Yes": Wins if the HYPE/USDT perpetual contract on Binance Futures records any traded price strictly above $78.00 at any point during Saturday, August 22, 2026 (UTC 00:00:00–23:59:59).
- "No": Wins if the HYPE/USDT perpetual contract on Binance Futures does not record any traded price strictly above $78.00 at any point during Saturday, August 22, 2026 (UTC 00:00:00–23:59:59).

Clarifications:
- "Any traded price" refers to the last traded price (mark price excluded) of the HYPE/USDT perpetual on Binance Futures; the daily high on Binance Futures for August 22, 2026 UTC is the canonical check.
- The datasource specified is the Binance USDⓈ-Margined perpetual futures, HYPEUSDT contract, 1-hour last-price klines via the official Binance Futures API.
